question.question:
D1 — I've rated this plan 2/10 on design completeness. The biggest gaps are centered-everything alignment, the 8px h1-to-subhead gap, and a CTA with no more weight than 'Learn more'. Mockups are unavailable (no designer binary), so I'll review all 7 dimensions text-only. Want me to focus on specific areas instead?
Project/branch/task: Marketing landing page plan on main.
ELI10: The review can cover every design angle or just a few. Covering all 7 catches gaps like mobile and accessibility that are cheap to fix now and expensive later.
Stakes if we pick wrong: Narrowing the scope leaves unreviewed gaps that engineers will fill with defaults.
Recommendation: A because your instructions ask for all seven dimensions and the plan is short.
Completeness: A=10/10, B=6/10
Pros / cons:
A) All 7 dimensions (recommended)
  ✅ Every gap is caught, including states, mobile, and accessibility
  ✅ Matches your stated request to review all seven dimensions
  ❌ More questions, roughly one per finding, before the plan is final
B) Layout/hierarchy only
  ✅ Faster, focused on the three issues the plan already names
  ❌ Leaves responsive, a11y, and states unspecified for engineering
Net: Full coverage costs a few more questions and avoids default-driven gaps.

options.label: All 7 dimensions (recommended)
options.description: Full review: IA, states, journey, AI slop, design system, responsive/a11y, unresolved decisions.

options.label: Layout/hierarchy only
options.description: Only the alignment, spacing, and CTA weight issues already in the plan.
